item.description: At the October 27, 2026, City Commission meeting, the Commission directed staff to prepare and present a Policies and Procedures Resolution for consideration, amending Resolution No. 2021-018, which establishes the rules and policies governing City Commission meetings. The proposed amendment would provide for email public comments to be included as supporting documentation to both the draft and final City Commission meeting Minutes. Currently, there is no legal requirement to publish public comments submitted by email or in printed form online as supporting documentation to meeting agendas or approved minutes. However, as a matter of standard practice, the City includes public comments received by email or in printed form as supporting documentation to the posted, approved meeting Minutes.

item.description: The Charter provides that at the first City Commission meeting after the election, the City Commission shall appoint one of its members to serve as Vice Mayor. Any member of the City Commission other than the Mayor may serve as Vice Mayor. Voting shall occur in the following manner: Voting shall be by ballot vote. Ballots will be cast and collected by the City Manager to be announced into the record. Each member of the Commission shall vote for one nominee in each round of voting until one person obtains more votes than the other. If no nominee obtains more votes than the others in round one, there is another round of voting but the nominee with the least number of votes does not move on to round two.
